Reset Net costs One line per supplier cost: the net amount and the supplier's currency. Net amount Currency Supplier note sells 1,492.54 USD Add net cost Settings Channel, selling currency, peak season and an optional override total. Channel B2C tailor-made Fixed departure B2B Selling currency USD EUR GBP AUD SGD Peak season dates (adds the rule's peak uplift) Override total (optional, in USD) Non-USD costs and selling currencies need a dated FX rate. Result Rule in force, FX rates used, each line in USD and selling currency, rounding, margin and the floor check.
